name: English
note: Reference catalogue for the gambitR3D app. Keys are stable; placeholders use braces.

messages.app.subtitle: Multilevel chess: play, analyse and train
messages.nav.label: Sections
messages.grid.main_meta.W: White main board, files b–e, ranks 1–4
messages.grid.main_meta.N: Neutral main board, files b–e, ranks 3–6
messages.grid.main_meta.B: Black main board, files b–e, ranks 5–8
messages.board.waiting: Waiting for the server to confirm the last action.
messages.board.not_interactive: No action can be made on this board now.
messages.board.no_action_to: {square} is not a legal destination for the piece on {from}. The selection is kept.
messages.board.no_actions_piece: The piece on {square} has no legal action.
messages.board.select_hint: Select a piece of the side to act to see its legal actions.
messages.board.no_answer: No answer from the server. The action was not confirmed and the board was not changed.
messages.board.canvas_label: 3D view of the three boards and four platforms. For keyboard play use the 2D view or the destination buttons below the board.
messages.board.fallback_webgl: The 3D view could not start in this browser (WebGL 2 is unavailable). The 2D view shows the same game; your selection and history are kept.
messages.board.fallback_lost: The 3D view stopped (the graphics context was lost). The 2D view shows the same game; your selection and history are kept.
messages.board.exploded_notice: Exploded inspection view: the boards are pushed apart for inspection only. Turn it off to see the true two-square gap between W and B.
messages.board.xray_notice: X-ray view: boards are see-through; a click offers every square under the pointer.
messages.board.level_notice: Showing only {board} and the platforms docked on it (display only).
messages.chooser.platform_note: Choose a destination dock and whether the platform keeps its orientation or turns 180°. The carried piece keeps its square; its coordinate changes.
messages.chooser.squares_xray: X-ray: several squares are under the pointer. Choose one:
messages.chooser.squares_occluded: A square with a legal action is hidden behind the nearest one. Choose:
messages.ack.invalid_request: The request could not be handled.
messages.ack.wrong_game: That action belongs to another game; the board has been updated.
messages.ack.stale_revision: The game changed before this action arrived; nothing was changed. Try again on the current position.
messages.ack.stale_state: The position changed before this action arrived; nothing was changed.
messages.ack.illegal_action: That action is not legal in the current position; nothing was changed.
messages.ack.game_over: The game has ended; no further action is possible.
messages.result.reason.halfmove: 100 plies without capture or pawn action
messages.mode.hotseat: Hotseat: both sides at this device
messages.play.untimed: Untimed game. Clocks are not offered in this release; untimed play is the only mode.
messages.play.draw_computer: Draw agreement is for hotseat games: the computer opponent does not evaluate draw offers in this release.
messages.play.undo_after_session_end: A resignation or agreed draw is final; start a new game instead.
messages.play.draw_confirm_body: Both players agree to end the game as a draw. This is recorded in the game and cannot be undone.
messages.play.resign_confirm_body: {side} resigns and the opponent wins. This is recorded in the game and cannot be undone.
messages.newgame.title: New game
messages.newgame.random_note: The random baseline picks a uniformly random legal action. It is a reference point, not a trained or thinking opponent.
messages.newgame.replace_note: The current game stays saved and can be resumed from Save and load.
messages.opponent.title: Opponent:
messages.opponent.progress_note: The search runs in a separate process; the app stays usable. Progress cannot be estimated, so no percentage is shown.
messages.opponent.cancelled: Stopped. The computer has not moved.
messages.moves.takebacks: {n} takeback(s) recorded in the game log; the retracted actions are kept there.
messages.files.title: Save and load
messages.files.load: Load a game or position file (.g3.json)
messages.files.not_saved_yet: Games are autosaved after every committed action to {dir}. Nothing has been saved in this session yet.
messages.files.error_unsupported: This file cannot be used by this version: {message}
messages.files.error_invalid: The file is not a valid game: {message}
messages.files.error_io: The file could not be read: {message}
messages.resume.label: Resume a game
messages.resume.text: Your last unfinished game ({white} – {black}, ply {ply}) was saved on {when}.
messages.rules.title: Rules
messages.rules.status_text: An experimental project convention, not an official rulebook.
messages.analyse.lead: Analysis works on a separate, unsaved branch of the game. Nothing here changes the live game, its turn or its save file.
messages.analyse.open: Open the current game for analysis
messages.analyse.empty: No analysis branch is open. Open the current game to explore it here.
messages.analyse.no_board: Open the current game to show its board here.
messages.analyse.branch_of: Branch {branch} of game {game}, copied at ply {ply}.
messages.analyse.viewing_earlier: Viewing ply {ply}. Moves are played at the end of the branch; use “Continue from this ply” to explore from here.
messages.analyse.running: Analysing ply {ply} with {nodes} nodes in a background process…
messages.analyse.not_run: No analysis yet. Results show alternatives scored by the search with the stated budget.
messages.analyse.stale: These results are for ply {ply}, not for the position shown.
messages.analyse.perspective: Scores are heuristic units from {side}'s point of view (the side to act).
messages.database.local_body: {n} game file(s) in {dir}. They are listed under Play → Save and load, where they can be resumed.
messages.database.local_hint: Each file is a complete native game record and can be loaded, replayed and validated with gambitR3D::g3_read_game().
messages.database.api_missing_body: The SQLite game database is not part of this build yet.
messages.database.api_no_path_body: The database API is installed, but the app was started without a database. Start it with a database path to connect one.
messages.database.api_present_body: Games of this app are saved to the database {path} and can be resumed from Play → Save and load. Import, filters and export are not yet wired into this section; use the R functions directly for now.
messages.coach.lead: Explanations of the game, grounded in the rules engine.
messages.coach.facts_title: Last action: facts from the engine
messages.coach.facts_note: These facts come straight from the engine's record of the move. They are not an evaluation.
messages.coach.no_move: No action has been played yet.
messages.coach.api_missing_body: Evidence-grounded coaching is not part of this build yet.
messages.coach.api_present_body: The coaching API is installed but this section is not yet wired to it.
messages.models.lead: Opponents that can play in this app.
messages.models.choose_hint: Choose an opponent with Play → New game → Against the computer.
messages.models.api_missing_body: No model registry is part of this build, so no trained model can be listed or played.
messages.models.api_present_body: The model registry API is installed but this section is not yet wired to it.
messages.training.practise_body: Exercises from analysed positions, with hints and scored attempts, for you.
messages.training.practise_missing: Exercises and scoring are not part of this build yet.
messages.training.opponent_body: Bounded training runs that produce a model checkpoint for the computer opponent.
messages.training.opponent_missing: The optional training runtime is not set up in this build.
messages.settings.lead: These preferences change only how the game is shown. They are never stored in the game and never change a move.
messages.settings.reduced_motion_note: Moves, platform transport and camera changes jump to their end instead of animating.
messages.settings.board_note: Changing the view or the Neutral height keeps the position, the legal actions and the history unchanged.
messages.settings.backend_file: Format: native game files (.g3.json), written atomically.
messages.settings.clock_note: Clocks are not available in this release; every game is untimed.
